item.title: Pandemic days: the fizz is out of the bottle
item.description:
Source: here.

Lockdown

Just this morning our brother remarked that the fear of the virus has inverted this month with respect to the actual infection. We literally hear this: in the past few months, while home-bound, we at least had aural quietness for most of the day, something we generally prefer.

Since the lock-down was lifted in our regions over the past two days we hear the loud blaring of music from the restaurant next door even as diners flock to it in throngs. We can only see those seated outside and do not know if any are seated inside. If it is only the former, it is a lesser evil, but the music is any case an annoyance for the still home-bound residents.
